## Primary Specializations (Tier 1)
- **Kitchen Remodeling:** Waterfall quartz islands, floor-to-ceiling custom millwork, load-bearing wall removal, open-concept conversions, appliance integration (Sub-Zero, Wolf, Thermador), under-cabinet architectural LED illumination.
- **Bathroom Remodeling:** Spa-grade wet rooms, curbless walk-in showers with concealed linear drains, freestanding soaking tubs, double custom floating vanities, 24-hour flood-tested Schluter waterproofing.
- **Full Home Remodeling:** Whole-house architectural floorplan re-engineering, double-height great rooms, slat fireplace accent walls, luxury walk-in closets, entertainer wet bars, cohesive tile/hardwood flooring transitions.

## Secondary Capabilities (Tier 2)
- **Home Additions:** Engineered CBS concrete block structural expansions, master suite wings, covered lanais, Florida hurricane wind-load compliance (140+ MPH).
- **Commercial Remodeling:** Boutique creative galleries, executive conference suites, tenant improvements (TI), light steel framing, Level 5 drywall, ADA accessibility compliance.
